rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are end-of-administration resignation letters accepting a Cabinet secretary's resignation effective January 20, 1961; both open by praising the secretary and staff, devote the central paragraph to a short catalog of departmental programs and measurable accomplishments, and close with thanks plus wishes for health and happiness upon leaving government service. The close dates and unusually specific parallel organization make the relationship materially stronger than generic resignation-letter similarity. C21 and C19 use much the same contemporary series format but are somewhat less closely matched in wording and organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in accepting your resignation, effective January 20, 1961, I wish to thank you for the many contributions you have made to the Nation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Commerce, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to pay tribute to you and your excellent staff.
shared_material.explanation: Both use nearly the same resignation-acceptance sentence, including the identical effective date, followed immediately by tribute to the official and staff.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Among the vital programs that you have worked for so effectively, these immediately come to mind
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Among the many significant accomplishments of your Department these past eight years, two deserve special mention
shared_material.explanation: These sentences perform the same transition into a selective catalog of signature departmental achievements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Food for Peace Program, which has helped raise the value of farm exports over the past seven years to $26.5 billion
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The new National Export Expansion Program, started this year, has done much to improve and expand services and information to help American business sell more abroad.
shared_material.explanation: Each central catalog explains named programs through their practical results, particularly increased exports.

shared_material.child_excerpt: through your determined and dedicated work, and the efforts of your fine staff
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For these activities, as well as the broad range of other functions you have supervised, you have my appreciation and thanks.
shared_material.explanation: Both move from selected accomplishments to broader appreciation for the secretary's overall administration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I again thank you and wish you a future life of good health and happiness as you leave government service.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As you leave government service, I wish you health and happiness in the years to come.
shared_material.explanation: The closing is a distinctive near-verbatim reuse of the same farewell formula.
